subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Chronology"** means the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence. (कालक्रम)

 
 
• **Example: **The **chronology** of the historical events helped the students understand the sequence of occurrences.
 
 
 
• **"Chronology" **refers to the science of arranging events in their order of occurrence in time. (कालक्रम)
 
 
• **Example: **Historians often rely on** chronology **to construct the narrative of past events.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is** 'Chronology**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Theology **(धर्मशास्त्र): The study of the nature of God and religious belief.

 
 
• **Example:** He pursued a degree in** theology **to better understand the doctrines of his faith.
 
 
 
• **Entomology **(कीटविज्ञान ): The scientific study of insects.
 
 
• **Example: **Her interest in **entomology** led her to discover several new species of beetles.
 
 
 
• **Psychology** (मनोविज्ञान): The scientific study of the human mind and its functions, especially those affecting behavior in a given context.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to major in **psychology **to better understand human behavior.
 
 

213:Tbf0,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
